title: JIT Compiling Code in 5μs
summary: A technical blog post by Matt Maislin explaining how to build a JIT compiler capable of compiling code in just 5 microseconds, demonstrating extreme optimization techniques for real-time code generation and execution.
problem_solved: Achieves near-instantaneous JIT compilation for scenarios requiring zero-latency code execution without perceptible compilation overhead.
why_valuable: Demonstrates practical extreme optimization techniques that enable use cases like REPLs, high-frequency trading, and hot code reloading where compilation latency must be imperceptible.
